title: Central alpha-2 agonists / 中枢α2受体激动剂（例：clonidine；methyldopa）

properties.Mechanism (MOA): Stimulate central α2 → ↓sympathetic outflow → ↓TPR and ↓CO → ↓BP. / 激动中枢α2 → 交感外流↓ → TPR↓+CO↓ → 血压↓。
properties.Contraindications: Avoid abrupt withdrawal; caution depression/sedation issues. / 避免突然停药；抑郁或嗜睡明显者慎用。
properties.Indications: Resistant hypertension; (methyldopa: pregnancy HTN in some settings). / 难治性高血压；（部分情况下methyldopa用于妊娠期高血压）。
properties.Adverse effects: Sedation, dry mouth, bradycardia; rebound hypertension if abruptly stopped (clonidine). / 嗜睡、口干、心动过缓；突然停药可反跳性高血压（clonidine）。
properties.Drug: Central alpha-2 agonists / 中枢α2受体激动剂（例：clonidine；methyldopa）
